name: Soybean Crush Spread: Oil vs Meal Divergence
description: Analyzes the board crush spread (total product value minus soybean cost) and the oil/meal divergence. Computes oil value (ZL×11), meal value (ZM×2.2), crush spread, oil share of product value, seasonal norms, and YoY changes. Dashboard includes crush spread time series, oil share divergence chart, product value breakdown, monthly seasonals, and a comprehensive summary table.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread: Oil vs Meal Divergence
# Board crush = (ZL×11 + ZM×2.2) - ZS
# Oil share = ZL×11 / (ZL×11 + ZM×2.2) — key divergence metric

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# ZL (Soybean Oil) — primary asset with proper continuation
src = market_data_source()()
zl_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
zl_close = zl_cont.c

# ZM (Soybean Meal) — reference futures
zm_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm_close = zm_ref.c

# ZS (Soybeans) — reference futures
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_close = zs_ref.c

# ============================================================================
# CRUSH SPREAD CALCULATIONS
# ============================================================================

# Product values per bushel (in cents)
oil_value = zl_close * 11           # ZL in cents/lb × 11 lbs/bu
meal_value = zm_close * 2.2         # ZM in $/ton × 0.022 tons/bu × 100 cents/$
total_product_value = oil_value + meal_value

# Board crush spread (cents/bushel)
crush_spread = total_product_value - zs_close
crush_ma20 = ma(period=20)(crush_spread)
crush_1yr_ago = crush_spread >> 252

# 52-week high/low of crush spread
crush_52wk_high = max(period=252)(crush_spread)
crush_52wk_low = min(period=252)(crush_spread)

# ============================================================================
# OIL SHARE (DIVERGENCE METRIC)
# ============================================================================

oil_share = oil_value / total_product_value
meal_share = meal_value / total_product_value
oil_share_ma20 = ma(period=20)(oil_share)

oil_share_52wk_high = max(period=252)(oil_share)
oil_share_52wk_low = min(period=252)(oil_share)

# ============================================================================
# YoY PERCENT CHANGES
# ============================================================================

zl_yoy = (zl_close / (zl_close >> 252)) - 1
zm_yoy = (zm_close / (zm_close >> 252)) - 1
zs_yoy = (zs_close / (zs_close >> 252)) - 1

# ============================================================================
# SEASONAL NORM (expanding mean per calendar month)
# ============================================================================

# Detect each month
is_jan = month_of_year(month=Month.January)()
is_feb = month_of_year(month=Month.February)()
is_mar = month_of_year(month=Month.March)()
is_apr = month_of_year(month=Month.April)()
is_may = month_of_year(month=Month.May)()
is_jun = month_of_year(month=Month.June)()
is_jul = month_of_year(month=Month.July)()
is_aug = month_of_year(month=Month.August)()
is_sep = month_of_year(month=Month.September)()
is_oct = month_of_year(month=Month.October)()
is_nov = month_of_year(month=Month.November)()
is_dec = month_of_year(month=Month.December)()

# Month number for bar chart labeling
month_num = conditional_select(is_jan, 1, is_feb, 2, is_mar, 3, is_apr, 4, is_may, 5, is_jun, 6, is_jul, 7, is_aug, 8, is_sep, 9, is_oct, 10, is_nov, 11, is_dec, 12, 0)

# Expanding mean of crush_spread for each month (mask → cumulative mean → pick)
cum_jan = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jan, crush_spread))
cum_feb = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_feb, crush_spread))
cum_mar = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_mar, crush_spread))
cum_apr = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_apr, crush_spread))
cum_may = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_may, crush_spread))
cum_jun = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jun, crush_spread))
cum_jul = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jul, crush_spread))
cum_aug = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_aug, crush_spread))
cum_sep = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_sep, crush_spread))
cum_oct = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_oct, crush_spread))
cum_nov = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_nov, crush_spread))
cum_dec = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_dec, crush_spread))

# Forward-fill each monthly cumulative to all bars, then select the right one
seasonal_norm = conditional_select(
    is_jan, ffill(cum_jan),
    is_feb, ffill(cum_feb),
    is_mar, ffill(cum_mar),
    is_apr, ffill(cum_apr),
    is_may, ffill(cum_may),
    is_jun, ffill(cum_jun),
    is_jul, ffill(cum_jul),
    is_aug, ffill(cum_aug),
    is_sep, ffill(cum_sep),
    is_oct, ffill(cum_oct),
    is_nov, ffill(cum_nov),
    ffill(cum_dec)
)

seasonal_dev_pct = (crush_spread - seasonal_norm) / abs(seasonal_norm)

# ============================================================================
# TIMESTAMP FOR XY_LINES
# ============================================================================

ts = index()

# ============================================================================
# 1. SUMMARY TABLE — Key Metrics
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Soybean Crush Spread Dashboard',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Crush Spread', 'Oil Share', 'YoY Changes', 'Seasonal'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Range Low', 'Range High'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, title='Current'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, title='52wk Low'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, title='52wk High'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, title='Current'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, title='52wk Low'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, title='52wk High'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, title='ZL YoY'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, title='ZM YoY'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, title='ZS YoY'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, title='Seasonal Norm'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, title='Seasonal Dev %'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, title='Crush 1yr Ago')
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Summary',
    order=0
)(crush_spread, crush_52wk_low, crush_52wk_high, oil_share, oil_share_52wk_low, oil_share_52wk_high, zl_yoy, zm_yoy, zs_yoy, seasonal_norm, seasonal_dev_pct, crush_1yr_ago)

# ============================================================================
# 2. CRUSH SPREAD OVER TIME (with 20d MA and 1yr ago)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Board Crush Spread (cents/bu)',
    category='2. Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='Cents / Bushel',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1yr Ago', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_spread, crush_ma20, crush_1yr_ago))

# ============================================================================
# 3. OIL SHARE DIVERGENCE CHART
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Oil Share of Product Value — Oil vs Meal Divergence',
    category='3. Oil Share Divergence',
    y_axis_label='Oil Share (fraction)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Oil Share', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.30, title='0.30 (Historical Low Band)', color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.40, title='0.40 (Historical High Band)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(oil_share, oil_share_ma20))

# ============================================================================
# 4. OIL VALUE vs MEAL VALUE PER BUSHEL
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Product Value Breakdown (cents/bu)',
    category='4. Product Value',
    y_axis_label='Cents / Bushel',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Oil Value (ZL×11)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Meal Value (ZM×2.2)', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(oil_value, meal_value))

# ============================================================================
# 5. MONTHLY SEASONAL AVERAGE CRUSH SPREAD
# ============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='Average Crush Spread by Month (All History)',
    category='5. Seasonality',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Cents / Bushel',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=4
)(values=crush_spread, label=month_num)

# ============================================================================
# 6. CRUSH SPREAD vs SEASONAL NORM
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Crush Spread vs Seasonal Norm',
    category='6. Seasonal Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Cents / Bushel',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Seasonal Norm', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=5
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_spread, seasonal_norm))
